title: Understand Summary Indexing Versus Search Acceleration
objectives: Understand Summary Indexing Versus Search Acceleration
Verify result values and the persisted operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture has three explicit source_logs events and starts with the clock paused. Keep it paused while configuring, then use clock controls or the Interview Workbench advance action for scheduled work.

Create an events index source_stats with retention=2592000 seconds. Create Summary comparison with search=index=source_logs | stats count by status, earliest=-15m, latest=now, and summary destination source_stats.

Run once and collect the summary, then query index=source_stats | stats sum(count) as total. Explain why persisted summary events differ from report/data-model acceleration. Native acceleration is a separate unsupported executor feature here; enabling auto_summarize does not create these summary rows.

hints: Inspect the source results and time window before saving or scheduling a report.
Use savedsearches.conf or simulated REST to independently verify the definition; inspect actual execution history and search the summary destination.
